Initial release of the PumpClaw token launcher skill.

- Instantly launch ERC20 tokens with 100% locked liquidity on Uniswap V4 (Base).
- No ETH deposit needed for token creation.
- Automated LP fee splits: 80% creator, 20% protocol; anyone can claim fees.
- Tokens are burnable, include on-chain image/website, and support gasless approvals.
- Adds command-line scripts for listing, creating, trading, and managing tokens and fees.
